Burkina Faso.title: Kangaba: six (6) dead in the collapse of a mining well in Nouga
Burkina Faso.summary: Kangaba, October 30 (AMAP) Six (6) people died Friday, in the collapse of a mining well, transformed into a gallery, in the rural commune of Nouga precisely in a very isolated gold mining site in the village of Dioulafoundou, learned AMAP from local sources. The same source specifies that the people who died are all nationals of Burkina Faso Immediately informed, the Prefect of Circle, accompanied by officials of the Police, the National Gendarmerie, the National Guard, the Civil Protection Rescue Center, the Sanitation and Water and Forestry Services, went to the scene.

Niger.title: In the first external move since 1973, Algeria deploys its forces in Niger
Niger.summary: The first Algerian military convoy arrived in the city of Arlit, northwest of Niger, with the aim of securing the country's vital economic interests and energy projects in the Sahel region of Africa. The deployment of Algerian troops outside the country is the first of its kind since Algeria sent troops to support Egypt during the 1973 war with Israel, in which Arab countries participated.
